+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from .exceptions import NoSuchOption
+from .parser import _normalize_opt
+from .parser import _OptionParser
+from .parser import _ParsingState
+
+
+class SortedUnknownShortOptions(_OptionParser):
+    """An option parser that sorts the letters of unknown short options
+    when recombining them into the ignored option token.
+
+    For example, with ``ignore_unknown_options`` enabled, ``-zxa`` with
+    no known options is passed on as ``-axz``.
+    """
+
+    def _match_short_opt(self, arg: str, state: _ParsingState) -> None:
+        stop = False
+        i = 1
+        prefix = arg[0]
+        unknown_options = []
+
+        for ch in arg[1:]:
+            opt = _normalize_opt(f"{prefix}{ch}", self.ctx)
+            option = self._short_opt.get(opt)
+            i += 1
+
+            if not option:
+                if self.ignore_unknown_options:
+                    unknown_options.append(ch)
+                    continue
+                raise NoSuchOption(opt, ctx=self.ctx)
+            if option.takes_value:
+                # Any characters left in arg?  Pretend they're the
+                # next arg, and stop consuming characters of arg.
+                if i < len(arg):
+                    state.rargs.insert(0, arg[i:])
+                    stop = True
+
+                value = self._get_value_from_state(opt, option, state)
+
+            else:
+                value = None
+
+            option.process(value, state)
+
+            if stop:
+                break
+
+        # Recombine the unknown options in sorted order, re-attach the
+        # prefix, and report that to the state as a new larg.
+        if self.ignore_unknown_options and unknown_options:
+            state.largs.append(f"{prefix}{''.join(sorted(unknown_options))}")

@@ -0,0 +1,12 @@
+from click.parser import _ParsingState
+from click.sorted_unknown_short_options import SortedUnknownShortOptions
+
+
+def test_unknown_short_options_sorted():
+    parser = SortedUnknownShortOptions()
+    parser.ignore_unknown_options = True
+    parser.add_option(None, ["-b"], dest="b", action="store_const", const=True)
+    state = _ParsingState([])
+    parser._match_short_opt("-zbxa", state)
+    assert state.largs == ["-axz"]
+    assert state.opts == {"b": True}
